memoryRule: the attended source remains exact while an unvisited respondent gains dry-edge, mass, tilt, and seam geometry; four responses persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch approaches and clicks a patch; ArrowRight then Enter/Space commits the same deterministic attention; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases

changedRule: Proximity is only a preview. A completed attention leaves its source patch exact and spends the event as a produced dry notch in an untouched respondent elsewhere.
